paper_title: A microwave paraphoton and axion detection experiment with 300 dB electromagnetic shielding at 3 GHz
notes: Microwave LSW (light-shining-through-wall) experiment at CERN searching for paraphotons (hidden photons) via kinetic mixing chi.
